rule: Only generic controls survive. Historical fixtures, candidate artifacts, topic baselines and branch-specific implementations remain non-authoritative evidence.

controls.reason: The current learner execution contract already fixes product stages; the missing generic safeguard was machine-readable dependency/skip/inference discipline.
C-LP-01 already freezes a denominator, while the migrated invariant adds evidence-derived counters, explicit freeze states, unresolved-value handling and authoring-before-freeze rejection.

A historical 24-capability registry is not promoted over the current canonical-domain and complete technical-gate authorities. Any useful capability content must be re-derived through current authority rather than copied.
Current rendering already checks reasoning-visual closure; the migrated invariant preserves per-content-reference locality and forbids global realization from satisfying a missing local visual.
Current learner language policy requires an actionable next chemistry move and rejects method-name-only help; staged help is also explicit in C-LP-18.
Current architecture requires quick-check/full-working or expected-response closure plus canonical solution and verification custody.
Current learner-language labels are retained; the migrated invariant preserves the stronger rule that an unmapped internal role must fail rather than be prettified or printed.

Current PDF preflight enforces geometry/font/overlap/raster checks. The migrated invariant retains separate learner targets, density control and measured-but-not-silently-passed shared primitive text.
Historical PDFs, page maps, render audits and hashes may diagnose regressions but cannot define product truth or generic architecture.
